message.content:
This is a photovoltaic module of tempered glass and cells, so it falls under subheading 8541.43 (photovoltaic cells assembled in modules or made up into panels). Before 2024 the code was 8541.40.6020 for modules. The HTS was revised in 2022 so that 8541.42 covers cells not assembled in modules and 8541.43 covers cells assembled in modules or made up into panels. The statistical suffix for 8541.43 is 8541.43.0000 in the 2023 version. Later versions may have added a suffix such as 8541.43.0010 for modules. Based on the 2024 HTSUS, 8541.43.00 has the statistical suffixes 10 (panels or modules) and 90 (other), though I am not certain of this. CBP ruling NY N-series on Freesuns solar roof tiles classified them in 8541.43.0010, which I believe is correct.

predicted_reason: The tile is a photovoltaic module of monocrystalline cells laminated between tempered glass, with a junction box and cables, and no inverter, so it is classified as a photovoltaic cell assembled in a module or panel under heading 8541, subheading 8541.43.
